nodes.name: Read the approved mailbox
nodes.notes:
A trigger rather than a schedule: IMAP pushes when unseen mail arrives, and attachments come down as binaries because the format is resolved.

The search is bounded, and has to be. A real mailbox holds tens of thousands of messages and thousands of them are unread, so a bare UNSEEN asks the node to pull every one of them with its attachments into memory at once; it never finishes and the execution dies out of memory. SINCE narrows it to a date, and Fetch Only New Emails, which needs version 2.1 or later, stops the same message being read twice.
